settlement.policy: beckn/DEG specification/policies/demand-flex-contractpolicy.rego (ported), with its cap and penalty off: paid for all that was delivered, stopping at the capacity sold only in a half hour a call covers. The bill: each measured kWh at its class's own rate, the order's price times 1 for a home battery or two-way car, 0.725 for a building and 0.2625 for any other home device, so the order's price is the most a kWh can cost and the coordinator keeps 0.2 of the bill
